chunks: He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali reported to me from his father, from Sa'ad ibn Abdillah, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Zaid ibn Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir, peace be upon them both, who said:

"When the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, was nearing his death, Jibrael descended and said to him: O Messenger of Allah, would you like to return? He said: No, I have already conveyed the messages of my Lord. Then he said to him: O Messenger of Allah, do you desire to return to the world? He said: No, but rather the Companion Most High. Then the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his progeny, said to the Muslims gathered around him: O people, indeed there is no Prophet after me, and no way after my way. So whoever claims that, then his claim and his innovation are in the Fire. And whoever claims that, then kill him, and whoever follows him, then they are in the Fire. O people, revive the law of retribution, and revive the truth, and do not be divided among yourselves. Submit and incline to peace, and you will be saved. 'Allah has decreed: I will certainly prevail, I and My messengers. Indeed Allah is Mighty, Potent' (58:21)."

key_terms.الرفيق الأعلى: The Companion Most High; the highest companionship in Paradise
key_terms.القصاص: Retribution; the law of just retaliation
key_terms.رسالات ربي: The messages of my Lord; the divine revelation

ai.seo_question: What were the Prophet Muhammad's final words to the Muslim community before his death?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrates the Prophet's final moments: when death approached, Jibrael offered the Prophet a return to the world, but the Prophet chose the Companion Most High, having already conveyed Allah's message. The Prophet then addressed the gathered Muslims with a solemn warning that there is no prophet after him and no way other than his way, commanding them to revive justice and truth, to remain united, and to submit to Allah. He concluded by quoting Quran 58:21 affirming that Allah and His messengers will prevail.
